description: This file provides various utility functions for formatting data such as dates, currency, numbers, initials, and phone numbers within a JavaScript (likely React) application. It includes functions to format dates into human-readable or relative formats, format numbers and currency amounts, extract initials from names, and style phone numbers for display.

methods.name: formatDate(date, formatStr = 'MMM d, yyyy')
methods.description: Formats a date string into a human-readable format, with a default pattern of 'MMM d, yyyy'. Returns '-' if the date is invalid or missing.

methods.name: formatRelativeDate(date)
methods.description: Formats a date as a relative time string such as '2 hours ago'. Returns '-' for invalid or missing dates.

methods.name: formatCurrency(amount, currency = 'USD', compact = false)
methods.description: Formats a number or string as currency, defaulting to USD, with options for compact notation and handling invalid input by returning '-'.

methods.name: formatNumber(num)
methods.description: Formats a number with commas for thousands separator. Returns '-' if input is null or undefined.

methods.name: getInitials(name, maxLength = 2)
methods.description: Extracts initials from a full name string, up to a maximum of two initials, in uppercase.

methods.name: getNameInitials(firstName, lastName)
methods.description: Generates initials from first and last name components, both optional, in uppercase.

methods.name: formatPhone(phone)
methods.description: Formats a 10-digit phone number into (XXX) XXX-XXXX format, or returns the original string if not 10 digits.
